episodes.155272: A surface front stalled near Kauai, along with an upper trough, brought heavy rain and thunderstorms to parts of the Aloha State, and flash flooding to Kauai.  Downpours over windward East Maui during this episode contributed to the death of a 26-year-old woman who was swept out to sea when Waioka Pond near Hana became swollen by waters coming down the slope from near the Haleakala summit.  The costs of any damages were not available.
episodes.155337: Southerly flow ahead of an approaching cold front resulted in strong moisture advection into South Florida. As insolation increased through the day, destabilization resulted in increasing showers and thunderstorms through the afternoon and evening. A few of these storms produced strong gusty winds over the Atlantic waters.
episodes.155338: Showers and storms developed ahead of an approaching cold front within an environment that was favorable for waterspout development. One of these storms produced a waterspout over the Gulf of Mexico just offshore Naples.
episodes.155454: A narrow line of showers and thunderstorms moved across Brevard County ahead of a cold front. Strong winds affected central Brevard County.

Nearby thunderstorms produced similar winds farther east on the Banana River and near Port Canaveral through 1455LST.
